```plato

    // Any unit vector perpendicular to `normal`. Crossed against whichever world
    // axis `normal` is least aligned with, so the construction never degenerates;
    // the resulting azimuth is arbitrary but stable, which is all a projection
    // basis needs. Precondition: normal is non-zero.
    PlaneTangent(normal: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => (normal.Z.Abs < 0.9 ? Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 1.0) : Vector3D(1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
            .Cross(normal).Normalize;
```
